text:
Ah, Christopher Columbus. The true pioneer of the 15th century, who didn’t just discover a continent but also invented the modern corporate strategy of "incremental innovation."

It is truly breathtaking to witness the sheer genius of repackaging the exact same product with a new color and a higher price tag. Who needs actual progress when you can have a "sleek adjective" slapped onto a mundane object? It’s not just marketing; it’s art. It’s the audacity to convince us that what we *really* need is the same thing we already have, just with a new name that sounds more expensive. One must admire the creativity involved in selling us the same old thing, but this time, it’s "Pro," "Max," or "Ultra." Because nothing says "revolutionary change" like a slightly shinier version of yesterday’s disappointment. Truly, the spirit of exploration lives on in the quarterly earnings report.
